admin.master.geographyNote: The 64 districts and 494 upazilas come from open data. Fix mistakes in supabase/seed and send a pull request. There is no editor here on purpose: hand-editing 494 rows of geography does more damage than it repairs.
eligibility.intro: Six questions. Answer honestly and you get an honest answer.
eligibility.needMore: Give your date of birth and weight and we can tell you.
eligibility.q.illness: Fever or illness in the last two weeks?
eligibility.q.illness.hint: A cold, a stomach bug, anything you took antibiotics for.
eligibility.q.tattoo: Tattoo or piercing in the last year?
eligibility.q.medication.hint: Blood pressure or diabetes medicine is usually fine. Tick it if you are unsure and ask at the hospital.
eligibility.yes.title: Yes, you can give blood
eligibility.yes.body: Register, and we will let you know when someone near you needs it.
eligibility.no.title: Not right now
eligibility.no.age: You need to be at least 18. Come back when you are.
eligibility.no.old: Blood is usually not taken after 65.
eligibility.no.weight: You need to weigh at least 45 kg. Giving blood below that can harm you.
eligibility.no.medication: Ask your doctor first. Many medicines are fine, but that is not ours to say.
eligibility.wait.title: You can give from {date}
eligibility.wait.cooldown: Your body needs 120 days after a donation. Give it the time.
eligibility.wait.illness: Wait at least two weeks after being ill.
eligibility.wait.tattoo: A year is the usual wait after anything done with a needle.
eligibility.disclaimer: This is guidance, not a medical clearance. The hospital will check you again before taking blood.

learn.intro: What is worth knowing about giving blood. Plainly, without overselling it.
learn.who.title: Who can give
learn.who.1: You need to be between 18 and 65.
learn.who.2: You need to weigh at least 45 kg.
learn.who.3: At least 120 days since you last gave.
learn.who.4: You need to be well on the day. Not with a fever or an infection.
learn.what.title: What happens when you give
learn.what.1: First they check your weight, blood pressure and haemoglobin. Plenty of people are sent home at this point, and there is no shame in it.
learn.what.2: Taking the blood is 8 to 10 minutes. The whole visit is about half an hour.
learn.what.3: One bag is 450ml, roughly a tenth of the blood in your body.
learn.what.4: A fresh needle is used every time. You cannot catch anything from the needle.
learn.after.title: Afterwards
learn.after.1: Sit for 10 to 15 minutes, drink water and eat something.
learn.after.2: No heavy work or exercise that day.
learn.after.3: The fluid comes back within a day. Red cells take a few weeks.
learn.myths.title: Things people believe that are not true
learn.truth.1: Not if you are healthy. You may feel tired for a few hours, then you are back to normal.
learn.myth.2: Giving regularly, or while fasting, damages you.
learn.truth.2: Every four months does no harm. Do not give while fasting; give after iftar.
learn.myth.3: My group is common, so nobody needs my blood.
learn.truth.3: The opposite. The commonest groups are the ones asked for most.
learn.truth.4: They can. If the weight and haemoglobin are fine, there is nothing stopping you.
learn.myth.5: You can catch something from the needle.
learn.truth.5: A new, single-use needle is used every time. There is no risk.
learn.cta.title: Can you give?
learn.disclaimer: This is general information. Talk to a doctor about your own situation.
privacy.intro: Read this before you type your phone number in. Five promises, every one of them enforced in the database.
privacy.p1.title: Your number is never shown on this site
privacy.p1.body: Not on a page, not in a list, not on the map. Nobody can get at it, however they ask.
privacy.p2.title: It goes to one person, once
privacy.p2.body: Only when you say yes to a request, and only to the person who made it. Never before.
privacy.p3.title: The map never shows where you really are
privacy.p3.body: Your public position is moved by up to 800 metres. The real one stays in the database.
privacy.p4.title: One tap stops everything
privacy.p4.body: Every email has the link. One tap and the emails stop and you come off the public list. No reason needed.
privacy.p5.title: No ads, and nobody is following you
privacy.p5.body: There are no trackers, no adverts and no third-party fonts on this site. Your data is never sold.
privacy.check.title: Do not take our word for it
privacy.check.body: All the code is open. Here is exactly where the rules are written.
